metadata.scenario: A customer calls to cancel their flight booking and requests information on refund eligibility due to a sudden plan change. Category: Cancellation. Flags: cancellation_risk.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Helen Johnson. I hope you’re doing well. Hi Helen! I'm doing well, thank you. How can I assist you today? I need to cancel my upcoming physical therapy appointment due to some sudden changes in my plans. I understand, Helen. I'm sorry to hear about your plans. When was your appointment scheduled for? It was set for Tuesday at 10 AM. I wanted to know if there's any refund eligibility for the missed session. Typically, we have a cancellation policy that requires at least 24 hours' notice for a full refund. I see, but what if it was an emergency situation? In cases of emergencies, we can review the situation and possibly offer a partial refund. That sounds fair. I really appreciate your understanding. Of course, Helen. Let me note that down. Do you want me to also cancel any future appointments? Yes, please. I’ll need to reevaluate my schedule before rescheduling. No problem. I’ll take care of that for you. Thank you. Is there a way to keep in touch regarding the physical therapy? Absolutely! We can set up a follow-up call to check on your status and reschedule when you're ready. That would be great. I’d like to ensure I don’t miss out on my recovery. I understand completely. How about I call you next week to see how you're doing? That works for me. Thank you so much for your help today! You're welcome, Helen! Is there anything else you’d like to discuss? Not at the moment, but I might need assistance with medication management later. We can help with that too! Just give us a call when you're ready. Will do. Thanks again, Margaret. You're very welcome, Helen. Take care and talk to you soon! Bye! Goodbye!
